title: drop_columns: remove unwanted columns from the dataset
description: Remove one or more columns from the dataset by name. Use this when the user wants to delete, drop, or remove columns they no longer need. Unlike select_columns (which keeps only the listed columns), drop_columns removes only the named columns and keeps everything else.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: List of column names to remove. All columns must exist in the dataset.

rag_note: Use drop_columns when the user mentions dropping, removing, or deleting specific columns. Use select_columns instead when the user says 'keep only these columns' or lists the columns to retain.
